question: Who Owns Burger King?
quick_answer: Burger King is owned by Restaurant Brands International (RBI), a publicly traded company that is also the parent of Tim Hortons, Popeyes and Firehouse Subs. RBI was formed in 2014 when Burger King merged with Tim Hortons. Burger King itself was founded in 1954 in Miami, Florida.
key_facts: RBI was formed in 2014 (Burger King + Tim Hortons merger)
Sister brands: Tim Hortons, Popeyes, Firehouse Subs

body.heading: Who owns Burger King?
body.text: Burger King is part of Restaurant Brands International, usually called RBI, one of the largest restaurant companies in the world. RBI is publicly traded and also owns Tim Hortons, Popeyes and Firehouse Subs, so Burger King shares a parent with those brands.

body.heading: How RBI was formed
body.text: RBI was created in 2014 when Burger King merged with the Canadian coffee chain Tim Hortons, a deal backed by the investment firm 3G Capital. Popeyes was later added in 2017 and Firehouse Subs in 2021, building RBI into a multi-brand group.

body.heading: The brand's roots
body.text: Burger King was founded in 1954 in Miami, Florida, and built its identity around the flame-grilled Whopper. It grew into a global fast-food giant before becoming the anchor brand of RBI.

faqs.q: Is Burger King owned by the same company as Popeyes?
faqs.a: Yes. Burger King, Popeyes, Tim Hortons and Firehouse Subs are all owned by Restaurant Brands International (RBI).

faqs.q: When was Restaurant Brands International formed?
faqs.a: RBI was formed in 2014 when Burger King merged with Tim Hortons, backed by 3G Capital.
Burger King was founded in 1954 in Miami, Florida.
